| 3 | **WIN_X_POS** | NUMBER(5,2) | N | 0 | X position on which called form will be open |

| 8 | **TERMINAL** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 9 | **TRN_DATE** | DATE | Y |  |  |
| 10 | **ORIGINAL_USER_ID** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 11 | **ORIGINAL_TERMINAL** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 12 | **ORIGINAL_TRN_DATE** | DATE | Y |  |  |

| 14 | **ZON_ID** | VARCHAR2(3) | Y |  | This column contains ZON_ID where record in created in table first time (Multi-Location Information) |

### GLOBAL_VARIABLES

This table contains definitions of Global variable those are mainatained at Application level This setup replicates variable values from context data to Db Global variables  and Application Global variables

| # | Column | Type | Null | Default | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **VARIABLE_ID** 🔑 | NUMBER | N |  | Store system generated variable ID |
| 2 | **VARIABLE_NAME** | VARCHAR2(30) | N |  | Store variable name that will be used by HIS as Global Variable |
| 3 | **DEFAULT_VALUE** | VARCHAR2(300) | Y |  | Store default constant value of variable |
| 4 | **INITIALIZE_FROM** | VARCHAR2(3000) | Y |  | Store function name that can be used to initialize value of global variable |
| 5 | **CHANGEABLE** | CHAR(1) | Y | 'N' | Store N or Y to check whether this variable value can be changed within a session of HIS |
| 6 | **REMARKS** | VARCHAR2(1000) | Y |  | Store user remarks for specified global variable |
| 7 | **ACTIVE** | CHAR(1) | N | 'Y' | Active state of Variable Y/N |
| 8 | **USER_ID** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 9 | **TERMINAL** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 10 | **TRN_DATE** | DATE | Y |  |  |
| 11 | **ORIGINAL_USER_ID** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 12 | **ORIGINAL_TERMINAL** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 13 | **ORIGINAL_TRN_DATE** | DATE | Y |  |  |
| 14 | **DATA_SOURCE** | CHAR(1) | Y |  | This column contains flag information to know data source of this global variable (F=Front-End, C=Context, Q=Query) |
| 15 | **ORDER_BY** | VARCHAR2(4) | Y |  | This coolumn contains order by position to display variable list is sequence |
| 16 | **MANDATORY** | CHAR(1) | Y | 'N' | This column contains information that this global variable is mondatory for login time |
| 17 | **ORG_ID** | VARCHAR2(3) | Y |  | This column contains ORG_ID where record in created in table first time (Multi-Location Information) |
| 18 | **ZON_ID** | VARCHAR2(3) | Y |  | This column contains ZON_ID where record in created in table first time (Multi-Location Information) |
| 19 | **LOC_ID** | VARCHAR2(3) | Y |  | This column contains LOC_ID where record in created in table first time (Multi-Location Information) |
| 20 | **WS_SYNC_DATE** | DATE | Y |  | This column contains WS_SYNC_DATE where record in created in table first time (Multi-Location Information) |

- **Primary key** `PK_GLOBAL_VARIABLES` (VARIABLE_ID)
- **Unique** `UK_GLOBAL_VARIABLES_1` (VARIABLE_NAME)
- **Check** `CK_GLOBAL_VARIABLES_1`: `(CHANGEABLE IN ('N','Y'))`
- **Check** `CK_GLOBAL_VARIABLES_2`: `(VARIABLE_NAME = UPPER(VARIABLE_NAME))`
- **Check** `CK_GLOBAL_VARIABLES_3`: `(ACTIVE in ('Y','N'))`
- **Check** `CK_GLOBAL_VARIABLES_4`: `(DATA_SOURCE in ('F','C','Q'))`
- **Triggers**: `GLOBAL_VARIABLES_CEA` (BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE), `GLOBAL_VARIABLES_DEL` (AFTER DELETE), `GLOBAL_VARIABLES_INS` (BEFORE INSERT), `GLOBAL_VARIABLES_UPD` (BEFORE UPDATE), `TRG_WS_QUS_UA_HQ_Q` (AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE)

### LOCATION_WISE_PATIENT_TYPES

| # | Column | Type | Null | Default | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **LOCATION_ID** 🔑 → `DEFINITIONS.LOCATION` | VARCHAR2(3) | N |  |  |
| 2 | **PATIENT_TYPE_ID** 🔑 → `DEFINITIONS.PATIENT_TYPE` | VARCHAR2(6) | N |  |  |
| 3 | **ACTIVE** | CHAR(1) | Y |  |  |
| 4 | **PREFIX_LOCTION_ID** | VARCHAR2(3) | Y |  |  |
| 5 | **DEFAULT_PATIENT_TYPE** | CHAR(1) | Y |  |  |
| 6 | **CONSTANT_ID** → `DEFINITIONS.PATIENT_TYPE_CONSTANT` | NUMBER(2) | Y |  |  |
| 7 | **COUNTER** | NUMBER(6) | Y |  |  |
| 8 | **PREFIX** | VARCHAR2(3) | Y |  |  |
| 9 | **INTER_CONVERSION** | NUMBER(3) | Y |  |  |
| 10 | **YEAR_WISE_COUNTER** | CHAR(1) | N | 'N' |  |
| 11 | **DEFAULT_LOCATION** | CHAR(1) | Y |  |  |
| 12 | **CONTRACT_AT_RUNTIME** | CHAR(1) | N |  | Values of this column must be Y and N. If vlaues of this column will be "N" then system will not attach the contracts at runtime, otherwise Invoice Procedure will attach the contracts at runtime and generate the invoice accordingly |
| 13 | **USER_ID** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 14 | **TERMINAL** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 15 | **TRN_DATE** | DATE | Y |  |  |
| 16 | **ORIGINAL_USER_ID** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 17 | **ORIGINAL_TERMINAL** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 18 | **ORIGINAL_TRN_DATE** | DATE | Y |  |  |
| 19 | **CAFE_FACILITY_ALLOWED** | CHAR(1) | N | 'N' | Values of this column must be Y or N, Y means Employee of this patient Type is allowed to buy food items from Cafe on Credit |
| 20 | **EMP_SALARY_CHECK** | CHAR(1) | N | 'Y' | It is a Common Business Rule that We will allow the employees who are on our payroll to buy Food Items from Cafe but there is some exception When a doctor is not on payroll then no need to check the Salary of that patient, in such cases Values of this column will be N |
| 21 | **CREDIT_LIMIT_SAL_PERCENT** | NUMBER(3) | N | 10 | How much an employee can avail of his/her salary as a Credit, This column is dependant of  above column (EMP_SALARY_CHECK), if values of the above column will be Y then this column is applicable |
| 22 | **PROVIDENT_FUND_CHECK** | CHAR(1) | N | 'Y' | If value of this column is Y then This Employee must be member of Provident Fund otherwise he/she is not eligible for Credit , if value of this column is N then System will not check the Provident Fund Membership |
| 23 | **CAFE_FACILITY_ALLOW_PROBATION** | CHAR(1) | N | 'N' | This column will be used to stop or allow the Employee for Cafe Facilities during Probation |
| 24 | **PI_PAYMENT_GL_PAYROLL** | CHAR(1) | N | 'N' | This column will be used for handling of Performer Practice Income through Payroll or GL, Practice Income Process will make decision on based of this flag and add payroll.allowance_deduction_detail table in case of G and Generate the GL voucher in case of G |
| 25 | **CAFE_DEDUCTION_GL_PAYROLL** | CHAR(1) | N | 'P' | This column will be used to define the setup whether Cafe Deduction of this Patient Type will be made through Payroll or GL. Values must be P and G, P for Payroll and G for GL |
| 26 | **REG_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED** | CHAR(1) | Y | 'N' | PURPOSE: Y -> REGISTRATION REQUIRED FOR PATIENT,   N-> NO REGISTRATION REQUIRED FOR PATIENT. |
| 27 | **FOOD_COUPON_ALLOW** | CHAR(1) | N | 'N' | Values of this Column will be Y or N, In case of Y system will generate the Food Coupon from invoice if other conditions meets, If values of this column is N then System will not generate the Food Coupon |
| 28 | **REG_VERIFICATION_REQUIED** | CHAR(1) | Y | 'N' |  |
| 29 | **INVOICE_RETURN_PREFIX** | CHAR(1) | Y |  | This column will be used to define the Invoice\ Return Prefix If New Invoice\ Return No. Counter is required for this  Patient Type, If Value of this column is not null then System will generate the Separate Invoice Counte for This patient Type and Add the Value of this column  in Invoice\ Return No. format :  LLL\|\|YY\|\|INVOICE_RETURN_PREFIX\|\|COUNTER_NO, Same Values will be added in Invoice and Return No. |
| 30 | **ALLOW_BBK_PRODUCT_ORDERING** | CHAR(1) | Y |  |  |
| 31 | **OBJECT_CODE** | VARCHAR2(11) | Y |  | This Column will be used to save object code of form or report if any decision required based on patient type and location |
| 32 | **URGENT** | CHAR(1) | Y | 'N' | This column contains info about urgent applicable for Radiology and Nuclear Medicine if its value is Y |
| 33 | **PATIENT_EDUCATION** | CHAR(1) | Y | 'N' | This column contains info about patient education applicable for physician Notes |
| 34 | **REPORT_VIEWED** | CHAR(1) | Y | 'N' | This column contains info about patient report viewed by any doctor. Y=Viewed , N=Not Viewed |
| 35 | **HIDE_TIME_GIVEN_PT_WO** | CHAR(1) | Y | 'N' | This column contains flag Y=Yes , N=Not Time given to Patient need to be Hide or not |
| 36 | **ADMISSION_ALLOWED** | CHAR(1) | N | 'N' | This column will be used to restrict/ allow the admission on specific location for specific patient type, by default Admission is restricted for all patient types, user has to allow manually |
| 37 | **CONTARCT_DAYS_FOR_CAFE** | NUMBER | Y | 0 |  |
| 38 | **ORG_ID** | VARCHAR2(3) | Y |  | This column contains ORG_ID where record in created in table first time (Multi-Location Information) |
| 39 | **ZON_ID** | VARCHAR2(3) | Y |  | This column contains ZON_ID where record in created in table first time (Multi-Location Information) |
| 40 | **LOC_ID** | VARCHAR2(3) | Y |  | This column contains LOC_ID where record in created in table first time (Multi-Location Information) |
| 41 | **WS_SYNC_DATE** | DATE | Y |  | This column contains WS_SYNC_DATE where record in created in table first time (Multi-Location Information) |
| 42 | **TAX_EXEMPTION** | CHAR(1) | Y |  |  |

- **Primary key** `PK_LOCATION_WISE_PATIENT_TYPES` (LOCATION_ID, PATIENT_TYPE_ID)
- **FK** `FK_LOCATION_WISE_PATIENT_1` (LOCATION_ID) → `DEFINITIONS.LOCATION` (LOCATION_ID)
- **FK** `FK_LOCATION_WISE_PATIENT_2` (PATIENT_TYPE_ID) → `DEFINITIONS.PATIENT_TYPE` (PATIENT_TYPE_ID) _DISABLED_

### PACKAGE_DETAIL

This table is almost parallel of definitions.package (1:1 relation), ADF team was using definitions.packages for C4I, as per ADF Team, if i shall add the column in definitions.packages there application will become invalid that's why Billing Team have created new table

| # | Column | Type | Null | Default | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **PACKAGE_ID** 🔑 → `DEFINITIONS.PACKAGES` | VARCHAR2(10) | N |  | Ref of Package |
| 2 | **TREATMENT_COVER** 🔑 | CHAR(1) | N | 'I' | Values will be O/I/E, O means OPD and I means IPD, E means EAR |
| 3 | **VALIDATION_PERIOD_REQUIRED** | CHAR(1) | N | 'N' | Values of this column must be Y or N, In case of Y User has to enter the Start and End Date |
| 4 | **START_DATE** | DATE | Y |  | Start date of the Package |
| 5 | **END_DATE** | DATE | Y |  | End date of the Package |
| 6 | **FROM_TIME** | VARCHAR2(5) | Y |  | From time of the Package |
| 7 | **TO_TIME** | VARCHAR2(5) | Y |  | To time of the Package |
| 8 | **HIDE_INVOICE_DETAIL** | CHAR(1) | N | 'N' | Values of this column must be Y or N, Y means Hide the CPT Detail on Invoice Report and Show only Package Name, N means Show CPT Detail |
| 9 | **USER_ID** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 10 | **TERMINAL** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 11 | **TRN_DATE** | DATE | Y |  |  |
| 12 | **ORIGINAL_USER_ID** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 13 | **ORIGINAL_TERMINAL** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 14 | **ORIGINAL_TRN_DATE** | DATE | Y |  |  |
| 15 | **PRICE_SOURCE** | CHAR(1) | Y | 'I' |  |
| 16 | **PROCESS_METHOD** | VARCHAR2(6) | Y | 'PREINV' | PRE INVOICE, POST INVOICE |
| 17 | **LIFE_SPAN** | NUMBER(3) | Y | 0 | Number of days for which a package can be availed after linked to patient. |
| 18 | **DEFAULT_PKG** | CHAR(1) | Y | 'N' |  |
| 19 | **DEPARTMENT_ID** | VARCHAR2(7) | Y |  |  |
| 20 | **SECTION_ID** | VARCHAR2(7) | Y |  |  |
| 21 | **ORG_ID** | VARCHAR2(3) | Y |  | This column contains ORG_ID where record in created in table first time (Multi-Location Information) |
| 22 | **ZON_ID** | VARCHAR2(3) | Y |  | This column contains ZON_ID where record in created in table first time (Multi-Location Information) |
| 23 | **LOC_ID** | VARCHAR2(3) | Y |  | This column contains LOC_ID where record in created in table first time (Multi-Location Information) |

### PACKAGE_ITEM

This table will be used to link the Items with the package

| # | Column | Type | Null | Default | Comment |

| 5 | **PRICE** | NUMBER(12,2) | N |  | This column will be used to save the Price of the Item (CPT, Drug, Item) within a Package, it can be different from original Table e.g.  CBC is 100 in definitions.cpt but it can 110 or 90 in this table |
| 6 | **NO_OF_ITEM_ALLOWED** | NUMBER | N | 1 | Total Number of Item Allowed will be entered, if value is zero then it is unlimited |
| 7 | **NO_OF_ITEM_AVAILED** | NUMBER | N | 0 | This column will represents the No. of Item Availed, it must be less or equal to NO_OF_ITEM_ALLOWED |
| 8 | **ACTIVE** | VARCHAR2(1) | N | 'Y' | Status of the Transaction |
| 9 | **ORG_ID** | VARCHAR2(3) | Y |  | This column contains Location ID for Multi-location info |
| 10 | **ZON_ID** | VARCHAR2(3) | Y |  | This column contains Zone ID for Multi-location info |
| 11 | **LOC_ID** | VARCHAR2(3) | Y |  |  |
| 12 | **USER_ID** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 13 | **TERMINAL** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 14 | **TRN_DATE** | DATE | Y |  |  |
| 15 | **ORIGINAL_USER_ID** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 16 | **ORIGINAL_TERMINAL** | VARCHAR2(30) | Y |  |  |
| 17 | **ORIGINAL_TRN_DATE** | DATE | Y |  |  |
| 18 | **WS_SYNC_DATE** | DATE | Y |  | This column contains WS_SYNC_DATE where record in created in table first time (Multi-Location Information) |

- **Primary key** `PK_PACKAGE_ITEM` (PACKAGE_ID, SERVICE_TYPE_ID, ITEM_ID)
- **FK** `FK_PACKAGE_ITEM_1` (PACKAGE_ID) → `DEFINITIONS.PACKAGES` (PACKAGE_ID)
- **FK** `FK_PACKAGE_ITEM_2` (SERVICE_TYPE_ID) → `DEFINITIONS.SERVICE_TYPE` (SERVICE_TYPE_ID) _DISABLED_
- **Check** `CK_PACKAGE_ITEM_1`: `(QUANTITY>=1)`
- **Check** `CK_PACKAGE_ITEM_2`: `(NO_OF_ITEM_ALLOWED>=1)`
- **Check** `CK_PACKAGE_ITEM_3`: `(NO_OF_ITEM_ALLOWED>=NO_OF_ITEM_AVAILED)`
- **Check** `CK_PACKAGE_ITEM_4`: `(ACTIVE IN ('Y','N'))`
- **Index** `INDX_PACKAGE_ITEM_1` (ITEM_ID)
- **Triggers**: `PACKAGE_ITEM_CEA` (BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE), `PACKAGE_ITEM_DEL` (AFTER DELETE), `PACKAGE_ITEM_INS` (BEFORE INSERT), `PACKAGE_ITEM_UPD` (BEFORE UPDATE), `TRG_WS_YTP_YK_UT_Q` (AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE)

## Views

### TEHSIL_AREA_2

Sources: `DISTRICT`

```sql
SELECT TEHSIL.TEHSIL_ID,
       UPPER(TEHSIL.NAME) TEHSIL_NAME,
       COUNTRY.COUNTRY_ID,
       COUNTRY.NAME COUNTRY_NAME,
       STATE.STATE_ID,
       STATE.NAME STATE_NAME,
       DISTRICT.DISTRICT_ID,
       DISTRICT.NAME DISTRICT_NAME
  FROM DEFINITIONS.DISTRICT,
       DEFINITIONS.STATE,
       DEFINITIONS.TEHSIL,
       DEFINITIONS.COUNTRY
 WHERE STATE.COUNTRY_ID = DISTRICT.COUNTRY_ID
       AND STATE.STATE_ID = DISTRICT.STATE_ID
       AND DISTRICT.COUNTRY_ID = TEHSIL.COUNTRY_ID
       AND DISTRICT.STATE_ID = TEHSIL.STATE_ID
       AND DISTRICT.DISTRICT_ID = TEHSIL.DISTRICT_ID
       AND COUNTRY.COUNTRY_ID = STATE.COUNTRY_ID
```

### VU_AD_COMMITTEE_MEMBERS

Sources: `AD_COMMITTEE_DEPARTMENT_WISE`, `AD_COMMITTEE_DEPT_SECTION_WISE`, `AD_COMMITTEE_DESIGNATION_WISE`, `AD_COMMITTEE_DESIG_CATEG_WISE`, `AD_COMMITTEE_MEMBERS`

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT "COMMITTEE_ID", "EMP_CODE", "REMARKS"
  FROM (SELECT M.COMMITTEE_ID, M.EMP_CODE, M.REMARKS
          FROM DEFINITIONS.AD_COMMITTEE_MEMBERS M
         WHERE M.ACTIVE = 'Y'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT MD.COMMITTEE_ID, C.MRNO, MD.REMARKS
          FROM DEFINITIONS.AD_COMMITTEE_DEPARTMENT_WISE MD,
               HRD.CURRENT_EMPLOYEES                    C
         WHERE MD.DEPARTMENT_ID = C.DEPARTMENT_ID
           AND MD.ACTIVE = 'Y'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT MDS.COMMITTEE_ID, V.MRNO, MDS.REMARKS
          FROM DEFINITIONS.AD_COMMITTEE_DESIGNATION_WISE MDS,
               HRD.VU_INFORMATION                        V
         WHERE MDS.DESIGNATION_ID = V.DESIGNATION_ID
           AND V.ACTIVE = 'Y'
           AND V.JOINING_DATE IS NOT NULL
           AND V.LEAVING_DATE IS NULL
           AND MDS.ACTIVE = 'Y'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT MDSC.COMMITTEE_ID, V.MRNO, MDSC.REMARKS
          FROM DEFINITIONS.AD_COMMITTEE_DESIG_CATEG_WISE MDSC,
               HRD.VU_INFORMATION                        V,
               DEFINITIONS.CATEGORY_WISE_DESIGNATION     C
         WHERE MDSC.DESIGNATION_CATEGOTY_ID = C.DESIGNATION_CATEGORY_ID
           AND C.DESIGNATION_ID = V.DESIGNATION_ID
           AND V.ACTIVE = 'Y'
           AND V.JOINING_DATE IS NOT NULL
           AND V.LEAVING_DATE IS NULL
           AND MDSC.ACTIVE = 'Y'
           UNION ALL
        SELECT DP.COMMITTEE_ID, V.MRNO, DP.REMARKS
          FROM DEFINITIONS.Ad_Committee_Dept_Section_Wise DP,
               HRD.VU_INFORMATION                        V
         WHERE DP.DEPARTMENT_ID = V.DEPARTMENT_ID
           AND DP.SECTION_ID = V.SECTION_ID
           AND V.ACTIVE = 'Y'
           AND V.JOINING_DATE IS NOT NULL
           AND V.LEAVING_DATE IS NULL
           AND DP.ACTIVE = 'Y')
 WHERE hrd.pkg_active_directory.f_is_committee_member_exempted(EMP_CODE,
                                                               COMMITTEE_ID) = 'N'
```

```sql
SELECT B.ROWID ROW_ID,
NVL(B.BED_ID,D.BED_ID) BED_ID,

       B.PHARMACY_BLOCKED,
       B.NURSE_MRNO,
       B.HOSPITALIST_MRNO,
       B.HOSPITALIST_NAME,

       B.TEMP_BS_DISCHARGE,
       B.MARKED_FOR_ALERT,
       B.NUTRITIONIST_MRNO,
       B.ADMISSION_TYPE,  --COLUMN ADDED FOR EAR on 14-Dec-2011 by Ali Noor
       R.LOCATION_ID ROOM_LOCATION_ID,
       R.ORDER_LOCATION_ID ROOM_ORDER_LOCATION_ID,
       NVL(D.FUNCTIONAL_ROOM_ID,D.ROOM_ID) ROOM_ID,
       D.BED_START_DATE,
       D.BED_END_DATE,
       D.AVAILABLE,
       D.ACTIVE,
       D.CATEGORY_ID,
       NVL(B.BED_STATUS,'N') BED_STATUS,
       D.BED_DESC,
       B.BED_LOCATION_ID,
       D.BED_CLEANING,
       D.BED_MAINTENANCE,
       D.BED_READY,
       D.BED_ID_ORDER_BY,
       D.CLEANING_DATE,
       D.READY_DATE,
       D.MAINTENANCE_DATE,
       D.LOCATION_ID ,
       D.ORGANIZATION_ID,
       D.FRAT_REQUIRED,
       D.FCP_REQUIRED,
       D.VIRTUAL,
       --code added by muzammal awais against cr 240000087 new columns added in definitions.beds table
       B.CURRENT_ADMISSION_LOCATION,
       B.PREVIOUS_ADMISSION_LOCATION
FROM   DEFINITIONS.DEF_BED D,
       DEFINITIONS.BEDS    B,
       DEFINITIONS.ROOMS R
WHERE  D.BED_ID  = B.BED_ID(+)
AND    NVL(D.FUNCTIONAL_ROOM_ID,D.ROOM_ID) = R.ROOM_ID(+)
AND    D.LOCATION_ID=R.LOCATION_ID
AND    D.LOCATION_ID=B.BED_LOCATION_ID(+)
```

### VU_CPT

Sources: `CPT`, `CPT_DEPARTMENT_SECTION`, `CPT_PRICE_HISTORY`

```sql
SELECT C.CPT_ID,
       LTRIM(SUBSTR(C.CPT_ID, 4), 0) DISP_CPT_ID,
       C.DESCRIPTION, C.PRICE,

       C.SURGERY_REGION_ID,
       SR.DESCRIPTION SURGERY_REGION,

       C.SPECIALITY_ID,
       CS.DESCRIPTION CLINIC_SPECIALITY,

       C.CPT_CATEGORY_ID CPT_CATEGORY_ID_CURRENT,
       CC.DESCRIPTION PACKAGE_CURRENT,

       C.CPT_CATEGORY_ID_NEW CPT_CATEGORY_ID_NEW,
       CCN.DESCRIPTION PACKAGE_NEW,

       C.INITIALIZED_YN,
       C.INITIALIZED_DATE,
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_DATE)
          FROM DEFINITIONS.CPT_PRICE_HISTORY
         WHERE CPT_ID = C.CPT_ID) LAST_EFFECTIVE_DATE,
       C.SHORT_DESC,
       C.LONG_DESC,
       C.ACTIVE,

       CDS.DEPARTMENT_ID,
       D.DESCRIPTION DEPARTMENT,

       CDS.SECTION_ID,
       DS.DESCRIPTION SECTION

  FROM DEFINITIONS.CPT               C,
       DEFINITIONS.CPT_CATEGORY      CCN,
       DEFINITIONS.CPT_CATEGORY      CC,
       DEFINITIONS.SURGERY_REGIONS   SR,
       DEFINITIONS.CLINIC_SPECIALITY CS,
       DEFINITIONS.CPT_DEPARTMENT_SECTION CDS,
       DEFINITIONS.DEPARTMENT_SECTION DS,
       DEFINITIONS.DEPARTMENT D
 WHERE (C.CPT_ID NOT LIKE '%S%'
   and C.CPT_ID NOT LIKE '%O%'
   and C.CPT_ID NOT LIKE '%P%')
   AND C.CPT_CATEGORY_ID_NEW = CCN.CPT_CATEGORY_ID(+)
   AND C.CPT_CATEGORY_ID = CC.CPT_CATEGORY_ID(+)
   AND C.SURGERY_REGION_ID = SR.SURGERY_REGION_ID(+)
   AND C.SPECIALITY_ID = CS.CLINIC_SPECIALITY_ID(+)
   AND C.CPT_ID = CDS.CPT_ID(+)
   AND CDS.DEPARTMENT_ID = DS.DEPARTMENT_ID(+)
   AND CDS.SECTION_ID = DS.SECTION_ID(+)
   AND DS.DEPARTMENT_ID = D.DEPARTMENT_ID(+)
   AND C.CPT_ID IN
   (SELECT CPT_ID
   FROM DEFINITIONS.CPT_DEPARTMENT_SECTION
   WHERE DEPARTMENT_ID='0013500')
```

Sources: `CPT`, `CPT_PRICE_HISTORY`

```sql
SELECT C.CPT_ID,

       C.INITIALIZED_DATE,
       (SELECT MAX(EFFECTIVE_DATE)
          FROM DEFINITIONS.CPT_PRICE_HISTORY
         WHERE CPT_ID = C.CPT_ID) LAST_EFFECTIVE_DATE,
       C.SHORT_DESC,
       C.LONG_DESC,
       C.ACTIVE,

       CDS.DEPARTMENT_ID,
       D.DESCRIPTION DEPARTMENT,

       CDS.SECTION_ID,
       DS.DESCRIPTION SECTION,
       C.NATURE_ID,
       C.NATURE_DETAIL_ID
  FROM DEFINITIONS.CPT               C,
       DEFINITIONS.CPT_CATEGORY      CCN,
       DEFINITIONS.CPT_CATEGORY      CC,
       DEFINITIONS.SURGERY_REGIONS   SR,
       DEFINITIONS.CLINIC_SPECIALITY CS,
       DEFINITIONS.CPT_DEPARTMENT_SECTION CDS,
       DEFINITIONS.DEPARTMENT_SECTION DS,
       DEFINITIONS.DEPARTMENT D
 WHERE C.CPT_CATEGORY_ID_NEW = CCN.CPT_CATEGORY_ID(+)
   AND C.CPT_CATEGORY_ID = CC.CPT_CATEGORY_ID(+)
   AND C.SURGERY_REGION_ID = SR.SURGERY_REGION_ID(+)
   AND C.SPECIALITY_ID = CS.CLINIC_SPECIALITY_ID(+)
   AND C.CPT_ID = CDS.CPT_ID(+)
   AND CDS.DEPARTMENT_ID = DS.DEPARTMENT_ID(+)
   AND CDS.SECTION_ID = DS.SECTION_ID(+)
   AND DS.DEPARTMENT_ID = D.DEPARTMENT_ID(+)
```

### VU_SET_OBJECT_PROPERTIES

Sources: `ORG_WISE_OBJECT_ITEM_SETUP`

```sql
SELECT OI.ITEM_NAME,
       IP.KEY_NAME,
       OIS.PROPERTY_ID,
       OIP.VALUE_SOURCE,
       OIS.ORG_ID,
       OI.OBJECT_CODE,
       IPV.VALUE_KEY,
       IT.TYPE_NAME,
       CASE
         WHEN IP.STATIC_VALUE = 'Y' THEN
          IPV.VALUE_KEY
         WHEN OIP.VALUE_SOURCE = 'O' THEN
          OIS.VALUE
          WHEN OIP.VALUE_SOURCE  = 'D' THEN
          T.TERM_NAME
       END PROPERTY_VAL
  FROM DEFINITIONS.ORG_WISE_OBJECT_ITEM_SETUP    OIS,
       DEFINITIONS.OBJECT_ITEM_PROPERTY OIP,
       DEFINITIONS.OBJECT_ITEM          OI,
       DEFINITIONS.ITEM_PROPERTY_VALUES IPV,
       DEFINITIONS.ITEM_PROPERTY        IP,
       DEFINITIONS.ITEM_TYPES IT,
       DEFINITIONS.TERMINOLOGY  T
 WHERE OIS.ITEM_ID = OIP.ITEM_ID
   AND OIS.PROPERTY_ID = OIP.PROPERTY_ID
   AND OIS.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID
   AND OIS.PROPERTY_ID = IPV.PROPERTY_ID(+)
   AND OIS.VALUE = IPV.VALUE_KEY(+)
   AND OIS.PROPERTY_ID = IP.PROPERTY_ID
   AND IT.TYPE_ID = OI.ITEM_TYPE_ID
   AND OIS.VALUE = T.TERM_ID(+)
   AND OIS.ACTIVE = 'Y'
   AND OI.ACTIVE = 'Y'
   AND OIP.ACTIVE = 'Y'
```

### VU_TOKEN_CARDS

Sources: `DEPARTMENT`, `SEQUENCE_SETUP`, `TOKEN_TYPE_TERMINALS`

```sql
SELECT S.SEQ_ID,
       TT.TOKEN_TYPE_ID,
       TT.BUTTON_LABEL,
       TT.BUTTON_LABEL_URDU,
       TT.BUTTON_IMAGE,
       TT.MRNO_IS_REQUIRED,
       S.LOCATION_ID,
       S.ORDER_LOCATION_ID,
       S.RECEPTION_ID,
       TT.DEPARTMENT_ID,
       TT.TOKEN_TYPE_DESCRIPTION,
       TR.TERMINAL_NAME,
       (SELECT D.DESCRIPTION
          FROM DEFINITIONS.DEPARTMENT D
         WHERE D.DEPARTMENT_ID = TT.DEPARTMENT_ID) DEPT_DESC
  FROM DEFINITIONS.SEQUENCE_SETUP S,
       DEFINITIONS.SEQ_TOKEN_TYPE ST,
       DEFINITIONS.ORDER_LOCATION_RECEPTION O,
       DEFINITIONS.TOKEN_TYPE TT,
       DEFINITIONS.TOKEN_TYPE_TERMINALS TR
 WHERE ST.SEQ_ID = S.SEQ_ID
   AND ST.LOCATION_ID = S.LOCATION_ID
   AND ST.RECEPTION_ID = S.RECEPTION_ID
   AND S.LOCATION_ID = O.LOCATION_ID
   AND S.ORDER_LOCATION_ID = O.ORDER_LOCATION_ID
   AND ST.TOKEN_TYPE_ID = TT.TOKEN_TYPE_ID
   AND TR.LOCATION_ID = ST.LOCATION_ID
   AND TR.LOCATION_ID = O.LOCATION_ID
   AND TR.RECEPTION_ID = O.RECEPTION_ID
   AND TR.SEQ_ID = ST.SEQ_ID
   AND ST.ACTIVE = 'Y'
   AND O.ACTIVE = 'Y'
   AND TT.ACTIVE = 'Y'
   AND TR.IS_TOKEN = 'Y'
   AND ST.RECEPTION_ID IN
       (SELECT LR.RECEPTION_ID
          FROM DEFINITIONS.TOKEN_TYPE_TERMINALS TR,
               DEFINITIONS.ORDER_LOCATION_RECEPTION LR
         WHERE LR.LOCATION_ID = TR.LOCATION_ID
           AND LR.RECEPTION_ID = TR.RECEPTION_ID
           AND TR.TERMINAL_NAME = TR.TERMINAL_NAME
           AND LR.ORDER_LOCATION_ID = O.ORDER_LOCATION_ID
           AND TR.IS_TOKEN = TR.IS_TOKEN)
```

```sql
SELECT RL.LOCATION_ID,
       NVL(RL.LOCATION_DESC, DL.DESCRIPTION) LOCATION_DESC,
       NVL(RL.SHORT_DESC, DL.SHORT_DESC) SHORT_DESC,
       NVL(RL.PHONE_NO, DL.PHONE) PHONE_NO,
       NVL(RL.FAX_NO, DL.FAX) FAX_NO,
       NVL(RL.EMAIL, DL.EMAIL) EMAIL,
       RL.START_DATE,
       RL.CLOSE_DATE,
       RL.ORDER_BY,
       (CASE
         WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN NVL(RL.START_DATE, SYSDATE + 1) AND
              NVL(RL.CLOSE_DATE, SYSDATE) THEN
          'ACTIVE'
         ELSE
          'INACTIVE'
       END) STATUS,
       DECODE(RL.SHOW_IN_REPORTS, 'Y', 'YES', 'NO') SHOW_IN_REPORTS,
       'YES' SHOW_IN_GRANT,
       'YES' ACTUAL_LOCATION,
       DL.ZON_ID,
       DL.ORGANIZATION_ID ORG_ID
  FROM DEFINITIONS.LOCATION DL, DEFINITIONS.LOCATION_SCHEMAS RL
 WHERE DL.LOCATION_ID = RL.LOCATION_ID
   AND RL.SCHEMA_ID='S01' AND DL.ORGANIZATION_ID=SYS_CONTEXT('GLOBAL_CONTEXT','ORGANIZATION_ID')
 UNION
SELECT 'ALG' LOCATION_ID,
       'All - Grouped by Location' LOCATION_DESC,
       'All - Distributed' SHORT_DESC,
       NULL PHONE_NO,
       NULL FAX_NO,
       NULL EMAIL,
       NULL START_DATE,
       NULL CLOSE_DATE,
       998 ORDER_BY,
       'INACTIVE' STATUS,
       'YES' SHOW_IN_REPORTS,
       'NO' SHOW_IN_GRANT,
       'NO' ACTUAL_LOCATION,
       SYS_CONTEXT('GLOBAL_CONTEXT','ZONE_ID') ZON_ID,
       SYS_CONTEXT('GLOBAL_CONTEXT','ORGANIZATION_ID') ORG_ID
  FROM DUAL
 UNION
SELECT 'ALS' LOCATION_ID,
       'All - Consolidated' LOCATION_DESC,
       'All - Summed' SHORT_DESC,
       NULL PHONE_NO,
       NULL FAX_NO,
       NULL EMAIL,
       NULL START_DATE,
       NULL CLOSE_DATE,
       999 ORDER_BY,
       'INACTIVE' STATUS,
       'YES' SHOW_IN_REPORTS,
       'NO' SHOW_IN_GRANT,
       'NO' ACTUAL_LOCATION,
       SYS_CONTEXT('GLOBAL_CONTEXT','ZONE_ID') ZON_ID,
       SYS_CONTEXT('GLOBAL_CONTEXT','ORGANIZATION_ID') ORG_ID
  FROM DUAL
```

### V_FILES_SERVERS_SYNC_SETUP

Sources: `FILES_SERVERS_SYNC_SETUP`, `LOCATION`

```sql
SELECT S.SERVER_ID SOURCE_ID,
       S.ACCESS_PATH SOURCE_PATH,
       S.LOCATION_ID SOURCE_LOCATION_ID,
       S.ACTIVE SOURCE_ACTIVE,
       D.SERVER_ID TARGET_ID,
       D.ACCESS_PATH TARGET_PATH,
       D.LOCATION_ID TARGET_LOCATION_ID,
       D.ACTIVE TARGET_ACTIVE,
       C.ACTIVE SETUP_ACTIVE,
       (CASE
         WHEN C.ACTIVE || '~' || S.ACTIVE || '~' || D.ACTIVE = 'Y~Y~Y' AND
              SYSDATE BETWEEN C.START_DATE AND NVL(C.END_DATE, SYSDATE) THEN
          'ACTIVE'
         ELSE
          'INACTIVE'
       END) STATUS,
       C.SYNC_MODE,
       C.START_DATE,
       C.END_DATE,
       C.PRIORITY,
       C.ACCESS_MODE
  FROM DEFINITIONS.FILES_SERVERS_SYNC_SETUP C,
       DEFINITIONS.FILES_SERVERS            S,
       DEFINITIONS.FILES_SERVERS            D
 WHERE C.SOURCE_SERVER_ID = S.SERVER_ID
   AND C.TARGET_SERVER_ID = D.SERVER_ID
   AND EXISTS
 (SELECT LOCATION_ID
          FROM DEFINITIONS.LOCATION L
         WHERE L.LOCATION_ID IN (S.LOCATION_ID, D.LOCATION_ID)
           AND L.ORGANIZATION_ID =
               SYS_CONTEXT('GLOBAL_CONTEXT', 'ORGANIZATION_ID'))
  /***********************************************************************************************
     PURPOSE: This View is used to fetch access paths and active statuses of Source and
              Destination servers along with other details of the SERVERS_SYNC_SETUP
     -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
     REVISIONS:
     Ver         Date          Author              Description
     ---------   -----------   -----------------   -------------------------------------------------
     1.0         20-Apr-2016   HAFIZ ABRAR AHMED   1. Created this View
  ************************************************************************************************/

```

### V_IP_ADDRESS

Sources: `PC_INFORMATION`, `TERMINAL_WISE_IPS`

```sql
SELECT I.IP_ADDRESS,
       I.IP_ROLE,
       I.COMMENTS,
       T.PC_NAME,
       TO_NUMBER(NVL(SUBSTR(I.IP_ADDRESS, 1, INSTR(I.IP_ADDRESS, '.', 1, 1) - 1),0)) ONE,
       TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(I.IP_ADDRESS,
              INSTR(I.IP_ADDRESS, '.', 1, 1) + 1,
              INSTR(I.IP_ADDRESS, '.', 1, 2) -
              INSTR(I.IP_ADDRESS, '.', 1, 1) - 1)) TWO,
       TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(I.IP_ADDRESS,
              INSTR(I.IP_ADDRESS, '.', 1, 2) + 1,
              INSTR(I.IP_ADDRESS, '.', 1, 3) -
              INSTR(I.IP_ADDRESS, '.', 1, 2) - 1)) THREE,
       TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(I.IP_ADDRESS, INSTR(I.IP_ADDRESS, '.', 1, 3) + 1)) FOUR,
       (SELECT P.DEVICE_CATEGORY_ID FROM MIS_INFO.PC_INFORMATION P
       WHERE P.PC_ID = T.PC_ID) DEVICE_CATEGORY_ID
       ,NVL(T.USER_ID,T.ORIGINAL_USER_ID)USER_ID,
       NVL(T.USER_ID,T.ORIGINAL_USER_ID) ||' - '||HRD.EMPLOYEE.get_name(p_mrno => NVL(T.USER_ID,T.ORIGINAL_USER_ID)) USER_NAME,
       NVL(T.TERMINAL,T.ORIGINAL_TERMINAL)TERMINAL,
       NVL(T.TRN_DATE,T.ORIGINAL_TRN_DATE)TRN_DATE
  FROM MIS_INFO.TERMINAL_WISE_IPS T, DEFINITIONS.IP_ADDRESS I
 WHERE I.IP_ADDRESS = T.IP_ADDRESS(+)
```

### V_RPC_ROLE

Sources: `ROLE`, `RPC_ROLE`

```sql
SELECT RPC.ROOM_PAYMENT_CATEGORY_ID RPC_ID,
       RT.CPT_RESTRICTION_TYPE_ID RESTRICTION_TYPE_ID,
       ORG.ORGANIZATION_ID ORG_ID,
       CR.ROLE_ID,
       CR.DESCRIPTION ROLE_DESC,
       CR.ROLE_TYPE,
       CR.ACTIVE ROLE_ACTIVE,
       ORG.ACTIVE ORG_ACTIVE,
       RT.ACTIVE CPTRT_ACTICVE,
       DECODE(RT.ACTIVE || '~' || CR.ACTIVE || '~' || ORG.ACTIVE,
              'Y~Y~Y',
              'ACTIVE',
              'INACTIVE') STATUS,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM DEFINITIONS.RPC_ROLE RPCR
         WHERE RPCR.RESTRICTION_TYPE_ID = RT.CPT_RESTRICTION_TYPE_ID
           AND RPCR.ROLE_ID = CR.ROLE_ID
           AND RPCR.ORGANIZATION_ID = ORG.ORGANIZATION_ID
           AND RPCR.RPC_ID=RPC.ROOM_PAYMENT_CATEGORY_ID) VISIT_CPTS
  FROM SECURITY.ROLE                    CR,
       DEFINITIONS.CPT_RESTRICTION_TYPE RT,
       DEFINITIONS.ORGANIZATION         ORG,
       DEFINITIONS.ROOM_PAYMENT_CATEGORY RPC
 WHERE CR.ROLE_TYPE = 'C'
   AND RT.CPT_GROUP_TYPE_ID = '00026'

         ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

         Ver        Date          Author                  Description

         1.0        03-Aug-2017   Abid Nazir              1. Created this View
  ******************************************************************************************************/

```

```sql
       DECODE(RT.ACTIVE || '~' || CR.STATUS|| '~' || ORG.ACTIVE,
```

```sql
       DEFINITIONS.SETUP_NATURE            SN, 
       DEFINITIONS.SETUP_NATURE_DETAIL     SND,
       DEFINITIONS.DEPARTMENT_NATURE       DN,
       DEFINITIONS.LOCATION                L,
       SECURITY.USERS                      U
 WHERE SN.SETUP_NATURE_ID      = SDA.SETUP_NATURE_ID
   AND DN.DEPARTMENT_NATURE_ID = SDA.DEPT_NATURE_ID
   AND L.LOCATION_ID           = SDA.LOCATION_ID
   AND SND.SETUP_DETAIL_ID     = SDA.SETUP_DETAIL_ID
   AND SND.SETUP_NATURE_ID     = SDA.SETUP_NATURE_ID
   AND SDA.ADMIN_BY            = U.MRNO
/***********************************************************************************************
       PURPOSE: This View is use to generate Queues.
       RESULT:
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       REVISIONS:
       VER        DATE         AUTHOR                  DESCRIPTION
       ---------  ----------   ---------------         -----------------------------------
       1.0        16-Aug-2019  Syed Gohar Ali          1. Create View.
************************************************************************************************/

```

### V_TOKEN_TYPE

```sql
             T.BUTTON_DESCRIPTION,
             T.MRNO_IS_REQUIRED,
```
